title: Trusted operator bootstrap discovery fallback
intent: Preserve explicit operator relay precedence while allowing signer-first CLI/operator clients to discover ContextVM transport relays from trusted service-authored NIP-51 relay sets when no final relay configuration is present.

included: CLI operator relay resolution flags and environment inputs
Shared operator client bootstrap discovery over NIP-51 kind 30002 relay sets
Deterministic tests for precedence, trust validation, relay-set selection, EOSE handling, fail-closed transport guard behavior, and failure modes
CLI user documentation for operator relay discovery
excluded: NIP-42 AUTH behavior for bootstrap or operator relays
NIP-34 repository relay routing and web repository helpers
Broad service-key rotation design beyond ordered trusted-pubkey selection
Commit or push workflow for this verification-only follow-up

intended_behavior: Explicit CLI --relay values are final and highest priority.
BAHIA_NOSTR_RELAYS is the second-priority final relay source when --relay is absent.
Trusted bootstrap discovery runs only when final relay sources are absent and both bootstrap relay seeds plus trusted service pubkeys are configured.
Discovery subscribes to trusted service-authored kind 30002 relay sets scoped to d=bahia-contextvm-v1 and d=bahia-browser-v1 until EOSE.
Discovery validates event ID, Schnorr signature, trusted author, reasonable timestamp, scoped d tag, and usable relay tags before trusting an event.
The bounded discovery wait is a fail-closed transport guard only; it never completes discovery, and relay sets are not selected until EOSE.
Usable bahia-contextvm-v1 relay sets are preferred over bahia-browser-v1 across trusted service pubkeys; browser relays are used only as deterministic fallback.

Multiple trusted service pubkeys are an ordered allowlist, not implicit key rotation: after relay-set purpose preference, the first configured trusted pubkey with a usable set wins, and parameterized replaceable latest-wins applies only within the same service pubkey and d tag, using the lowest event ID for equal created_at ties.
Missing bootstrap inputs, missing trusted pubkeys, untrusted/invalid events, no trusted events before EOSE, or no EOSE before the bounded wait fail with explicit errors.
